title: Bram and the Deadline
author: Gideon Blackwood
blurb: Theo Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
